ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_norm_weighted_with_costgap
ir.intuition: Normalize weights per batch to enforce scale-invariance and stabilize loss magnitude, incorporating cost gap as quality signal.
ir.pseudocode:
norm_weight = weight / sum(weight + eps)
loss = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw - lpl), -20, 20))
cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))
weighted_loss = loss * norm_weight * cost_gap
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    zeros = lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape)
    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', zeros) - batch.get('cost_a', zeros))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 0.6752757766189963))
    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    norm_weight = ops.div(weight, ops.add(ops.sum(weight), eps))
    weighted_loss = loss * norm_weight * cost_gap
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
